data.reasoning: The package is a standard -bin AUR package that downloads a verified binary from the official upstream GitHub repository. The sunshine.install script performs standard post-install tasks required for a game streaming application (setting POSIX capabilities and loading kernel modules for virtual input devices). data.disagreement_analysis: The disagreement was caused by a transient API error (HTTP 400) in the qwen model when attempting to audit sunshine.install, resulting in an overall inconclusive verdict. The deepseek model successfully audited the same file and correctly identified its contents as safe and expected for the application.
coverage_issues: qwen model failed to review sunshine.install due to an LLM API error, leaving a coverage gap that resulted in an inconclusive verdict.
learnings: Implement retry logic or fallback mechanisms for individual file audits when an LLM API call fails, to prevent a single transient error from causing an overall inconclusive verdict.
When orchestrating multiple models, aggregate file-level verdicts to fill in coverage gaps caused by transient errors in one model before declaring the overall audit inconclusive.
